question: What claim is made about the yoginī named Icchā and the extent of her domain?
premises: She is known by the siddhas.
By supreme will her domain extends up to Māyā.
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, known to the siddhas, extends up to Māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact nature of this extension is not detailed here.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to Māyā.
